caption: The drawing depicts a large, upright wooden cabinet with two rectangular doors extending the height of the front face. The cabinet is composed of brown wood characterized by visible, irregular grain patterns and knots throughout its surface. The doors are framed with horizontal and vertical wood panels, and there is a slight shadow or darkness where the two doors meet in the center. The cabinet stands on four short, turned and rounded legs at each corner, and the top has a slightly protruding cornice with an angular edge. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or designs present. The overall appearance of the cabinet is symmetrical and the depiction focuses on the wood texture and natural color variations from light to dark brown.
title: Wardrobe, John Marshall's
